text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Reduction of Portuguese public sector deficit in 1996 to fulfil the Maastricht criteria was due to a temporary increase in revenues, which makes it unsustainable in the long term, a report from the European Monetary Institute said.
- Chairman of Spain's Telefonica, Juan Villalonga, and Portuguese Minister of Planning and Public Works, Joao Cravinho, meet today to agree exchange of shares between Telefonica and Portugal Telecom.

- Under-Secretary of Industry and Energy, Jose Penedos, said Electricidade de Portugal (EDP) would not received any of the funds from its planned privatisation, apparently contradicting view of his boss, Economy Minister Augusto Mateus, who has said some funds would be used to finance the internationalisation of the company.

- The liabilities of Gestres, part of banking group Espirito Santo, will exceed its assets by 3.5 billion escudos if it does not sell its participation of 43.4 pct in private aviation company, Portugalia.
